name: Cost Accounting
description: The course introduces students to managerial cost accounting. It covers topics such as job costing, activity-based costing, process costing, allocation of support-department costs, inventory costing and capacity analysis, cost behavior, and cost-volume-profit analysis. Further, in SoSe 2026 an additional module on "AI in Cost Accounting" is added covering current trends, available technologies and their application in Cost Accounting.
prerequisites: The course will be offered in English only.
